sources.title: Rookie safety Miles Scott is an ascending talent who will push for a roster spot
sources.description: With their first of three 7th round selections in the 2026 NFL Draft, the Denver Broncos selected Illinois safety Miles Scott to add some more depth to their secondary. He’s a 5-11, 210-pound safety prospect with 4.62 speed and a 37.5-inch vertical. He started his college career as a wide receiver before transitioning to safety […]
